title: Rizia/Turn 10/DEFAULT GATHERING SCENE/DEFAULT HOUSE AZARO CONVO

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The general turned his wheelchair a..."
entries.dialogueText: The general turned his wheelchair around to face me.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Congratulations on a successful ev..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations on a successful evening, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't tell you how happy I am to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't tell you how happy I am to see you back in good health, General."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You haven't said a word about my n..."
entries.dialogueText: "You haven't said a word about my new partner. Do you approve?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus smiled."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus smiled.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The doctors are calling it a mirac..."
entries.dialogueText: "The doctors are calling it a miracle recovery."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you make of all the recent..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you make of all the recent protests, General?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You seem to be in good health thes..."
entries.dialogueText: "You seem to be in good health these days, General."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How is everything in Cardesse-Mont..."
entries.dialogueText: "How is everything in Cardesse-Montaklar?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As both your security councilor an..."
entries.dialogueText: "As both your security councilor and a high-ranking noble, I'm obviously concerned."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I have to say I'm concerned, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to say I'm concerned, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I recognize the feeling in the air..."
entries.dialogueText: "I recognize the feeling in the air. It was exactly the same in 1926."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believe we can put an end to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe we can put an end to the unrest. But I will need House Azaro's support."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That revolt could have ended peace..."
entries.dialogueText: "That revolt could have ended peacefully had the Crown been willing to meet the protesters' demands for reform."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand now why my father mad..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand now why my father made that deal with Wehlen. Desperation can make a ruler contemplate the unthinkable."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""In fact, I would say I'm well enou..."
entries.dialogueText: "In fact, I would say I'm well enough to assume my prior position on the Royal Council."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""With careful management, I could s..."
entries.dialogueText: "With careful management, I could stay on the Royal Council for years to come."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His features hardened."
entries.dialogueText: His features hardened.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Very much so, Your Majesty. The do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very much so, Your Majesty. The doctors call it a miracle recovery."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Have you forgotten that they kille..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you forgotten that they killed my brother? That they almost killed you?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""These people can't be compromised..."
entries.dialogueText: "These people can't be compromised with. They will be satisfied with nothing less than our blood."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""And what are you thinking now, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what are you thinking now, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is a pity to be losing so many..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a pity to be losing so many trusted advisors. But I am following the path of God now."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Except that the Royal Council is a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Except that the Royal Council is about to dissolve."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Except, of course, that you saw fi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Except, of course, that you saw fit to replace my disgraced daughter with your bodyguard."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Assuming my daughter allows it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Assuming my daughter allows it."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Except, of course, that the Royal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Except, of course, that the Royal Council is about to dissolve."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I don't want the traitors to win a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want the traitors to win any more than you do, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""But I must say, it won't be easy f..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I must say, it won't be easy for us to help you without the ability to mobilize our own forces."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""If His Majesty would have me, of c..."
entries.dialogueText: "If His Majesty would have me, of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will handle the riots and bring..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will handle the riots and bring peace to the realm. Your province need not get involved."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I agree, Father. The time for peac..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree, Father. The time for peaceful compromise is long past."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We are already involved, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are already involved, Your Majesty. There are riots on our streets as well as yours."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Enough with the false modesty, Tad..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough with the false modesty, Taddeus. His Majesty is lucky to have you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I don't just allow it, I encourage..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't just allow it, I encourage it. I'll have my hands full raising our new heir."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Of course, Father. I was only keep..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Father. I was only keeping your seat warm for you, anyway."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was reluctance in Lucita's vo..."
entries.dialogueText: There was reluctance in Lucita's voice as she answered.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I had my reasons for appointing Ti..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had my reasons for appointing Titus. The Azaros could not be trusted after what Lucita did."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Captain Gordion is more than a mer..."
entries.dialogueText: "Captain Gordion is more than a mere bodyguard. His seat on my council is well deserved."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You were not yet fully recovered b..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were not yet fully recovered back then. Petition for the security councilor seat this year, and I will consider reinstating you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed his head."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed his head.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I will gladly do so, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will gladly do so, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I do not question Gordion's compet..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not question Gordion's competence. But I will point to my years of experience serving your father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I nonetheless thank you for your m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I nonetheless thank you for your many years of service. You deserve a long, happy retirement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fear not, General. There will stil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fear not, General. There will still be a place for you when Rizia is reborn."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As is its destiny. All things must..."
entries.dialogueText: "As is its destiny. All things must come to an end, Taddeus."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Yes... I know. But I wish I could..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... I know. But I wish I could have served you for longer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your daughter has gone above and b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your daughter has gone above and beyond in her service to the Crown, Taddeus. You should be proud of her."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With all due respect, the time of..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, the time of King Valero has passed. The Royal Council needs fresh blood."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Petition for the council seat when..."
entries.dialogueText: "Petition for the council seat when the time comes, General. I will place you under special consideration."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now, Lucita, I thought you were a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, Lucita, I thought you were a modern woman. You can raise a child and have a career at the same time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled wryly."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled wryly.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I am, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I will be once we win the war.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will be once we win the war."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""If it's fresh blood you're looking..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it's fresh blood you're looking for, I could put myself forward."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I hadn't heard. But raising a chil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hadn't heard. But raising a child, fulfilling my duties as Queen Consort *and* serving on your council? It's too much, Romus."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thank you. You will be hearing fro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. You will be hearing from me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita smiled gently."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita smiled gently.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Don't discount my father's years o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't discount my father's years of experience, both serving King Valero and leading our troops."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I don't think you have the tempera..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think you have the temperament to sit through a lengthy council session, Carlos."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""And you do?""
entries.dialogueText: "And you do?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""With that said, if you did insist..."
entries.dialogueText: "With that said, if you did insist I continue my council duties, I could hardly refuse His Majesty's request."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I made a royal decree to centraliz..."
entries.dialogueText: "I made a royal decree to centralize our armed forces. I cannot simply reverse it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see what you're getting at, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see what you're getting at, but it's not going to happen. I can't grant Rizia's royal houses the means to strike against me."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You're so afraid of being usurped..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're so afraid of being usurped that you'd let the revolutionaries strike against us all?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I didn't want to say this, but you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't want to say this, but you sound just like your father."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""And why not? You are the King -- f..."
entries.dialogueText: "And why not? You are the King -- for now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, I cannot authorize this. I com..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I cannot authorize this. I command you to help the Crown against the revolutionaries with whatever other resources are at your disposal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus frowned."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus frowned.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We will try, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will try, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus and Lucita looked at one an..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus and Lucita looked at one another.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""In addition, we want your assuranc..."
entries.dialogueText: "In addition, we want your assurance that should my child be a boy, he will take his rightful place as successor to the Rizian throne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw Carlos' hands form fists."
entries.dialogueText: I saw Carlos' hands form fists.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw Lucita's hands form fists."
entries.dialogueText: I saw Lucita's hands form fists.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your Majesty, I promise we will he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I promise we will help you as best we can, under the circumstances."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The unrest will come to all of us..."
entries.dialogueText: "The unrest will come to all of us sooner or later. As it did back then."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nonetheless, I'm reluctant to reso..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonetheless, I'm reluctant to resort to violence. I'm holding out hope this can be resolved by other means."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""But with most of our house embroil..."
entries.dialogueText: "But with most of our house embroiled in the war, we don't have the resources to properly crack down on them."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""House Azaro will help you..""
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro will help you.."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We want your assurance that should..."
entries.dialogueText: "We want your assurance that should our child be a boy, he will take his rightful place in the Rizian line of succession."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""This is not only what House Azaro..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is not only what House Azaro wants. It will bring stability and strength back to the kingdom in the wake of the uprising."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The Azaro army will help you to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaro army will help you to the best of our ability."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos saluted."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos saluted.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Loud and clear, General. The rebel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Loud and clear, General. The rebellion doesn't stand a chance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry, Lucita, but I can't gua..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Lucita, but I can't guarantee that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course royal tradition will be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course royal tradition will be respected. If we have a boy, he will inherit the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have no idea if Vina is even ali..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no idea if Vina is even alive or dead. As far as I'm concerned, Lucita's child is my only heir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My wife stepped backwards, shaken."
entries.dialogueText: My wife stepped backwards, shaken.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You can't?""
entries.dialogueText: "You can't?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I made a promise to Vina long ago...."
entries.dialogueText: "I made a promise to Vina long ago. I can't break it."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""But I think we should change the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I think we should change the subject."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may be right. Does that mean H..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may be right. Does that mean House Azaro will support the Crown in the fight against the revolutionaries?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My mother's portrait. Do you like..."
entries.dialogueText: "My mother's portrait. Do you like it?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The depiction you chose truly brou..."
entries.dialogueText: "The depiction you chose truly brought a tear to my eye, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""When we win Pales, it will become..."
entries.dialogueText: "When we win Pales, it will become a reality."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Should Rizia find itself at war ag..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should Rizia find itself at war again, the Queen Mother will be one of our top recruits."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Ah... I'm no art critic, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah... I'm no art critic, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It was a beautiful tribute, Romus...."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a beautiful tribute, Romus. Everyone here thinks so."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Nor am I. But it definitely looked..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nor am I. But it definitely looked like the Queen Mother."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""But if you say the Crown has the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if you say the Crown has the situation under control, I will not challenge you."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Agreed. The time for peaceful comp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. The time for peaceful compromise is long past."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A willingness to compromise is wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "A willingness to compromise is what makes a truly great leader. I know the Crown and the protesters will see eye to eye in the end."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You have more faith in the commone..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have more faith in the commoners than I do... But perhaps you're right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what would House Azaro do in m..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what would House Azaro do in my place?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We wouldn't let the traitors win...."
entries.dialogueText: "We wouldn't let the traitors win. That's for certain."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's not entirely true, Father...."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not entirely true, Father. We could pull one of our units from the front and deploy them against the revolutionaries."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Hm... We could.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hm... We could."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Under one condition.""
entries.dialogueText: "Under one condition."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's true, Your Majesty. We'd ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's true, Your Majesty. We'd have to increase recruitment for our provincial army in order to get the necessary manpower."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Even then, most of our house is em..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even then, most of our house is embroiled in the war. We'd need to institute a massive recruitment drive in order to get the necessary manpower."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and Lucita looked at one another..."
entries.dialogueText: He and Lucita looked at one another.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Excellent. I knew I could count on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent. I knew I could count on you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's all I wanted to know. I've..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's all I wanted to know. I've got to go mingle with the other guests now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's all I would have to do to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's all I would have to do to get you on my side? Increase the size of our provincial armies?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's all I would have to do to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's all I would have to do to get you on my side? Give the provinces back the ability to raise their own armies?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand. I'll have to solve t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. I'll have to solve the problem on my own, then."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that your only condition for le..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that your only condition for lending your support? That Rizia bring back our provincial levies?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough of this. I shall deal with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough of this. I shall deal with the traitors on my own. Including your house, when the time comes."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Are you sure, Your Majesty? The ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure, Your Majesty? The riots greatly affect us in Cardesse-Montaklar as well."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You would also have to allow us to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You would also have to allow us to double our recruitment numbers, so that we don't have to pull troops from the front."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was hoping for a solution that d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was hoping for a solution that didn't involve the military."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus' brow furrowed."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus' brow furrowed.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your Majesty, I promise we will he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I promise we will help you as best we can, under the circumstances."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I only hope it is not too little,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only hope it is not too little, too late."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus folded his arms across his..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus folded his arms across his chest, making sure his medals were still visible.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your father and I learned this in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your father and I learned this in 1926, Your Majesty. Brute force is the only language these animals speak."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos nodded his assent."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos nodded his assent.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. So you're saying if I r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. So you're saying if I reinstate provincial levies, the Azaros will help us against the revolutionaries?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't believe that at all. I wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't believe that at all. I will not ask your house to get involved in this."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We will try our best to avoid esca..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will try our best to avoid escalating the situation, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I wish you the best of luck with i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish you the best of luck with it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have my own ways of applying bru..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have my own ways of applying brute force, if it comes down to it."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Then it sounds like you don't need..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then it sounds like you don't need us at all."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I wish you the best of luck with t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish you the best of luck with the situation."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Give us the capability and the res..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give us the capability and the resources, and we will do our part to crush the rebellion to a bloody pulp."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well, General. By royal decre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well, General. By royal decree, I will bring back Rizia's provincial army system and increase levies to twice their original size."
entries.menuText: "Very well, General. By royal decree, I will bring back Rizia's provincial army system and increase levies to twice their original size." [Restore And Increase Provincial Levies]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina wants to be queen more than a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina wants to be queen more than anything. I can't take that away from her."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For political reasons, I must name..."
entries.dialogueText: "For political reasons, I must name my daughter as successor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Succession law shouldn't favor son..."
entries.dialogueText: "Succession law shouldn't favor sons. You have to admit it's a sexist policy."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But, Romus... we don't even know w..."
entries.dialogueText: "But, Romus... we don't even know where Vina is."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And after the way she humiliated y..."
entries.dialogueText: "And after the way she humiliated you, does she even deserve to be your heir?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We're doing our best to coordinate..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're doing our best to coordinate her rescue, but realistically, she might not make it back."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But, Romus... what about us?""
entries.dialogueText: "But, Romus... what about us?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My wife breathed a sigh of relief."
entries.dialogueText: My wife breathed a sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Thank you, Romus. That means so mu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Romus. That means so much."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our child will represent the union..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our child will represent the union of House Toras and House Azaro. A new way forward for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me with pleading eyes..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me with pleading eyes.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I know how much you love Vina. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know how much you love Vina. But if she loves you too, she'll understand."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My wife stroked my arm."
entries.dialogueText: My wife stroked my arm.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Vina will come back, Romus. And wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina will come back, Romus. And when she does, she'll understand."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If we don't band together against..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we don't band together against the unrest, the protesters could kill us all. Are you seriously willing to put our unborn child's life at risk over this?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes... you're right. *If* we have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... you're right. *If* we have a son, he will take Vina's place as successor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We don't even know the sex of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't even know the sex of our child yet. I will make this decision when the time comes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well, General. By royal decre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well, General. By royal decree, I will bring back Rizia's provincial army system."
entries.menuText: "Very well, General. By royal decree, I will bring back Rizia's provincial army system." [Restore Provincial Levies]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand. I'll have to tackle..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. I'll have to tackle the problem on my own, then."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. So you're saying if I r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. So you're saying if I raise provincial levies, the Azaros will help us against the revolutionaries?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I'm sure. Let's change the su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I'm sure. Let's change the subject."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We can offer a unit from our provi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can offer a unit from our provincial army. With no wars on the horizon, our men and women have been looking for a fight."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. I request that you depl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. I request that you deploy your forces to quell the rebellion."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, I wish we could help. But eve..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I wish we could help. But even with provincial recruitment at a maximum, House Azaro can't spare the troops."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I command you to aid the Crown wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I command you to aid the Crown with whatever resources are at your disposal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand. I won't burden your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. I won't burden your house with this on top of the war."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She breathed a sigh of relief."
entries.dialogueText: She breathed a sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you truly love *me*, you'll und..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you truly love *me*, you'll understand why I have to put my daughter first."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at her father apologetic..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at her father apologetically.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm not. Father, we have to do som..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not. Father, we have to do something."

entries.dialogueText: "We have to do something."

entries.dialogueText: "And as for our troops, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "In that case, Your Majesty, House Azaro is at your disposal."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thank you for your trust in us, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your trust in us, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Carlos, I want you to get word to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Carlos, I want you to get word to Camp Domus about this immediately. There's no time to waste, understand?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thank you for your trust in us. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your trust in us. We will not fail you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All three houses, defending the Cr..."
entries.dialogueText: "All three houses, defending the Crown together. This will be a triumph to remember."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Understood.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understood."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Always.""
entries.dialogueText: "Always."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We will savor it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will savor it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did away with provincial levies..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did away with provincial levies for a reason. I still think it's too risky for provinces like Cardesse-Montaklar to command their own armies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Azaro army is large enough alr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaro army is large enough already. You will help crack down on the traitors with the troops you currently have."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My deepest apologies, but I cannot..."
entries.dialogueText: "My deepest apologies, but I cannot grant your request. It is not your house I distrust, but the others."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Then there is nothing we can do, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then there is nothing we can do, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""God help us all.""
entries.dialogueText: "God help us all."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Best of luck to you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Best of luck to you."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We will try, but I fear it will no..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will try, but I fear it will not be enough."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""If the noble houses can't trust ea..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the noble houses can't trust each other after all this time, perhaps Rizia deserves to fall."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Azaros bowed and walked to the..."
entries.dialogueText: The Azaros bowed and walked to the far corner of the room.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Aside from the riots, you mean?""
entries.dialogueText: "Aside from the riots, you mean?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""To be honest, Your Majesty, the pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be honest, Your Majesty, the protests are beginning to worry me."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Yes, we are doing our best to cont..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we are doing our best to contain what's happening in our province. But the fury with which people have taken to the streets is quite alarming."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As well as can be, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As well as can be, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The announcement of Rizia's new th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The announcement of Rizia's new theocratic direction threw many of us for a loop, myself included."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It was a surprise to many of us in..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a surprise to many of us in the capital as well, Father."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Don't get me wrong, I'm an observa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't get me wrong, I'm an observant Wruhecist. But the dissolution of the Royal Council? It will take some time to get used to."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me pointedly."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me pointedly.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I will tell you that some in our p..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will tell you that some in our province are still outraged over Duchess Lucita's imprisonment, as justified as it may be."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lucita, you told me some time ago..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita, you told me some time ago that House Azaro had complaints about my reign. Is that still the case?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Father is being too diplomatic to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father is being too diplomatic to tell you that Rumburg's sudden intervention in the Pales war was not well received."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Father is being too diplomatic to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father is being too diplomatic to tell you that our decision to bring Wehlen into the Pales war was not particularly well received."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Father is too modest. You'll be re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father is too modest. You'll be rechristening the streets in the Palesian capital in no time."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""We continue to watch our Palesian..."
entries.dialogueText: "We continue to watch our Palesian neighbors with caution. There are those who believe Reinhart's conciliatory attitude is all an act."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Not that I am one of them.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not that I am one of them."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But as long as Pales is restored t..."
entries.dialogueText: "But as long as Pales is restored to us, House Azaro will be happy to see an end to the fighting."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But with time, our citizens will s..."
entries.dialogueText: "But with time, our citizens will see the necessity of your decision."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The war continues to strain resour..."
entries.dialogueText: "The war continues to strain resources, but our house remains optimistic."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita shot him a troubled glance."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita shot him a troubled glance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita nodded in affirmation."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita nodded in affirmation.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We'll deliver a full report on Tot..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll deliver a full report on Total Tranquility later. Now's not the time for war talk."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We'll deliver a full report later...."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll deliver a full report later. Now's not the time for war talk."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've caught me in a good mood. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've caught me in a good mood. Is there anything your house requests of your King today?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope that our holy kingdom can c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope that our holy kingdom can count on your continued support. We will need your military prowess for the many crusades ahead."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Still, we are prepared to support..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, we are prepared to support the Crown through the transition."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope I can count on the Azaros'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope I can count on the Azaros' continued support. You are among my family's oldest and most important allies."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus glared at his daughter ster..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus glared at his daughter sternly.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What? I was only being honest.""
entries.dialogueText: "What? I was only being honest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With the House of Delegates abolis..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the House of Delegates abolished and the royal houses of Toras and Azaro united once more, I've been thinking the military should play a greater role in how Rizia is governed."

entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to you and your house for joining us tonight. If you'll excuse me, I'm going to freshen up my drink."

entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I can tell you now that the late K..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can tell you now that the late King Valero always had his suspicions about your... leanings. But having seen you and Princess Lena together, I never would have guessed."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""To be honest, I wasn't surprised i..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be honest, I wasn't surprised in the least."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: She looked me in the eye.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My most heartfelt of congratulatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "My most heartfelt of congratulations to you and Mr. Adria. I mean it."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""It's an unusual predilection for a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's an unusual predilection for a Rizian king. But you and Mr. Adria have my most heartfelt of congratulations."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I... yes, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... yes, of course."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I can tell you now that the late K..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can tell you now that the late King Valero always had his suspicions about your... leanings. But having seen you in action in the military, I was shocked to hear the news."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I can tell you now that the late K..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can tell you now that the late King Valero always had his suspicions about your... leanings. I never would have guessed, myself."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Father. Are you saying that one ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father. Are you saying that one can't prefer the company of men and be a skilled soldier at the same time?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Look at the Derdians, Taddeus. Hel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at the Derdians, Taddeus. Hell, I'm beginning to think we should mandate homosexuality in basic training."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your congratulations are accepted.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your congratulations are accepted."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mandatory homosexuality in the mil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mandatory homosexuality in the military... I feel a new decree coming on."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You had better mean it. Anyone who..."
entries.dialogueText: "You had better mean it. Anyone who dares to challenge the legitimacy of the King's new partnership is a traitor to the realm."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What exactly did my father say abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly did my father say about me, General Taddeus?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope all of Cardesse-Montaklar s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope all of Cardesse-Montaklar shares your tolerance."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We will see to it that they do.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will see to it that they do."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Horrified looks spread across the A..."
entries.dialogueText: Horrified looks spread across the Azaros' faces.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""That was meant as a joke, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was meant as a joke, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your Majesty... perhaps those opin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... perhaps those opinions are best left buried with him."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He winced."
entries.dialogueText: He winced.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus hurriedly interjected."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus hurriedly interjected.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We are all very happy for you, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are all very happy for you, Your Majesty. We'll see to it that Cardesse-Montaklar celebrates your new love as well."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""It will take some time for the peo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will take some time for the people of our province to accept this news. But we'll see to it that they do."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I wasn't very lucid at the time, b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wasn't very lucid at the time, but I do recall talk amongst our house that you had intentions to reform the monarchy against the nobility's will."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Fortunately, it seems we were mist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, it seems we were mistaken."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your Majesty, I assure you that Ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I assure you that House Azaro does not harbor any ill will against the Crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who was spreading such rumors? Tel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who was spreading such rumors? Tell me, and I'll have them hanged."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, you were. There will be no an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, you were. There will be no anti-nobility reforms on King Romus' watch, mark my words."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""*If* I were planning to reform the..."
entries.dialogueText: "*If* I were planning to reform the country, I would not do so against your house's will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I allowed Manus Sazon to plead his..."
entries.dialogueText: "I allowed Manus Sazon to plead his case for reform, yes. But ultimately, I rejected his misguided ideas."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Surely you don't believe that Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Surely you don't believe that Rizia can stay the same forever. A kingdom must adapt to the changing times and the will of its people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus paled."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus paled.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Nobody in particular.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody in particular."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""That may be so. But such decisions..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be so. But such decisions must be made in consultation with provincial leaders."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Good to hear.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good to hear."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Hmm. So you don't deny your intent..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. So you don't deny your intentions?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Especially not since one of our ow..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially not since one of our own is now a part of the Royal Family."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Especially not on the Queen Mother..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially not on the Queen Mother's birthday."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""If that is indeed the case, then I..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that is indeed the case, then I assure you House Azaro does not harbor any ill will towards the Crown."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""In any case, Your Majesty, you mus..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, Your Majesty, you must believe that House Azaro harbors no ill will against the Crown."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Just one, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just one, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Now that victory in Pales is all b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that victory in Pales is all but a certainty, House Azaro humbly wishes to resume its governance of the region."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Should we achieve victory in Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should we achieve victory in Pales, House Azaro humbly wishes to resume its governance of the region."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Resume? Pales hasn't even been a p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Resume? Pales hasn't even been a part of Rizia for over two centuries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course, General. For your servi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, General. For your service during this war and the one that preceded it, you deserve it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That may be true. But we Azaros ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be true. But we Azaros have long memories."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pales will be in a state of instab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales will be in a state of instability after it is reconquered. It needs the full attention of the Crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We centralized Zille following its..."
entries.dialogueText: "We centralized Zille following its return. I was planning on doing the same with Pales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus bowed so deeply he almost f..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus bowed so deeply he almost fell off his wheelchair.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You are too generous, my liege.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are too generous, my liege."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We have fought the Palesians twice..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have fought the Palesians twice. Do you truly believe we can't handle a little instability?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""So you would give our house the sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you would give our house the same treatment as the Sazons? The traitors?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't foresee a happy ending to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't foresee a happy ending to this war. Chances are that no one in Rizia will end up governing Pales."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Don't count us out just yet, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't count us out just yet, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If it truly means that much to you..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it truly means that much to you, I will consider your request. Once we win, that is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With Wiktor Smolak now involved, t..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Wiktor Smolak now involved, the decision may be out of my hands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By the time the war is over, the d..."
entries.dialogueText: "By the time the war is over, the decision may be out of my hands."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both Azaros looked at me strangely."
entries.dialogueText: Both Azaros looked at me strangely.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""What do you mean, out of your hand..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean, out of your hands? You're the King."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We cannot allow Wehlen to control..."
entries.dialogueText: "We cannot allow Wehlen to control us yet again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why do you want Pales so badly, an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why do you want Pales so badly, anyway? It'll be a smoking ruin by the time our armies are done with it."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""But very well...""
entries.dialogueText: "But very well..."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""But it will give us the sea, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it will give us the sea, Your Majesty. Something all the other provinces have that we in Cardesse-Montaklar lack."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We *will* win Pales. And when we d..."
entries.dialogueText: "We *will* win Pales. And when we do, I hope you will think of us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus and Lucita looked at each o..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus and Lucita looked at each other. Finally, Lucita spoke up gently.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We do have one request.""
entries.dialogueText: "We do have one request."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, good. I'd hate to think that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, good. I'd hate to think that any of you were plotting against me."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your Majesty, I can't express how..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I can't express how happy I am that you and my daughter are expecting a child."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""And my greatest hope is that if th..."
entries.dialogueText: "And my greatest hope is that if that child is male, he will take his rightful place as successor to the throne of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry, Taddeus, but I cannot g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Taddeus, but I cannot guarantee that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course royal tradition will be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course royal tradition will be respected. If we have a boy, he will inherit the throne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My wife stepped backward, shaken."
entries.dialogueText: My wife stepped backward, shaken.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You can't?""
entries.dialogueText: "You can't?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our child will represent the union..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our child will represent the union of House Toras and House Azaro. A new way forward for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have no idea if Vina is even ali..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no idea if Vina is even alive or dead. As far as I'm concerned, Lucita's child is my only heir."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I made a promise to Vina long ago...."
entries.dialogueText: "I made a promise to Vina long ago. I can't break it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And after the way she humiliated y..."
entries.dialogueText: "And after the way she humiliated you, does she even deserve to be your heir?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We're doing our best to coordinate..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're doing our best to coordinate her rescue, but realistically, she might not make it back."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Thank you, Romus. That means so mu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Romus. That means so much."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me with pleading eyes..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me with pleading eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes... you're right. *If* we have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... you're right. *If* we have a son, he will take Vina's place as successor."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at Taddeus apologeticall..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at Taddeus apologetically.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We don't even know the sex of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't even know the sex of our child yet. I will make this decision when the time comes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She breathed a sigh of relief."
entries.dialogueText: She breathed a sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you truly love *me*, you'll und..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you truly love *me*, you'll understand why I have to put my daughter first."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""No, of course I'm not!""
entries.dialogueText: "No, of course I'm not!"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I know how much you love Vina. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know how much you love Vina. But if she loves you too, she'll understand."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are you saying? Are you *hopi..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you saying? Are you *hoping* my daughter never returns?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I am sure His Majesty will make th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sure His Majesty will make the right decision when the time comes, Father. We shouldn't press the issue while Her Highness is still missing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus sighed in frustration. Luci..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus sighed in frustration. Lucita looked at him apologetically.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""He's right, Father. We're getting..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's right, Father. We're getting ahead of ourselves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina wants to be queen more than a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina wants to be queen more than anything. I can't take that away from her."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For political reasons, I must name..."
entries.dialogueText: "For political reasons, I must name my daughter as successor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A male heir ought not to be favore..."
entries.dialogueText: "A male heir ought not to be favored over his female older sibling. I intend to change that sexist policy."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But, Romus... what about us?""
entries.dialogueText: "But, Romus... what about us?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But, Romus... we don't even know w..."
entries.dialogueText: "But, Romus... we don't even know where Vina is."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My wife breathed a sigh of relief."
entries.dialogueText: My wife breathed a sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My wife stroked my arm."
entries.dialogueText: My wife stroked my arm.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Vina will come back, Romus. And wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina will come back, Romus. And when she does, she'll understand."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Yes, all right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, all right."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus sighed in frustration. Luci..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus sighed in frustration. Lucita looked at him apologetically.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I am sure His Majesty will make th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sure His Majesty will make the right decision when the time comes, Father. We shouldn't press the issue now."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""If you can't guarantee us Pales, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you can't guarantee us Pales, I would hope you can promise this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and Lucita looked at each other."
entries.dialogueText: He and Lucita looked at each other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos smiled, showing all his teet..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos smiled, showing all his teeth as he did so.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""The alliance between our two house..."
entries.dialogueText: "The alliance between our two houses is the bedrock on which Rizia stands, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Well put, Carlos.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well put, Carlos."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos removed his hat and smiled s..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos removed his hat and smiled sincerely.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus put a hand to his chest."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus put a hand to his chest.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The alliance between our two house..."
entries.dialogueText: "The alliance between our two houses is the bedrock on which Rizia stands, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw a hint of sorrow in Taddeus'..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw a hint of sorrow in Taddeus' eyes.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Never in a million years, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never in a million years, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I swear you can count on my family..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear you can count on my family's loyalty, {RiziaDLCText.LucitaToPlayer}."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still have to convince the other..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still have to convince the other houses. But the Azaros are the most vital piece of the puzzle."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Good luck.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Taddeus, the Viscount of Nelvisar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Taddeus, the Viscount of Nelvisar has been waiting all night to congratulate you on your recovery. Shall we?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Father, the Viscount of Nelvisar h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father, the Viscount of Nelvisar has been waiting all night to congratulate you on your recovery. Shall we?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Yes. Please excuse us, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Please excuse us, Your Majesty."
