entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I do have one wish.""
entries.dialogueText: "I do have one wish."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus raised an eyebrow in his di..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus raised an eyebrow in his direction.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Only that you enjoy the evening as..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only that you enjoy the evening as much as we have."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus shook his head.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I have visited my cousin -- Lucita..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have visited my cousin -- Lucita -- in prison. She swears she is innocent."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I hope there will be.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope there will be."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You are most welcome, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are most welcome, Your Majesty. But I do wish I could have served you for longer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you saying that you know bette..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you saying that you know better than the international courts?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm truly sorry, but I cannot exon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm truly sorry, but I cannot exonerate Lucita as long as Rizia remains allied with Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course, she'll never admit to h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, she'll never admit to her guilt. I thought you were too smart to fall for her lies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It doesn't matter. By imprisoning..."
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't matter. By imprisoning her, we avoided a war that would have cost us thousands of lives."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""No, Your Majesty...""
entries.dialogueText: "No, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I understand...""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand..."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I know Lucita well, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "I know Lucita well, Your Majesty. I don't believe she's lying."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I understand... I think.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand... I think."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus put a hand on his cousin's..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus put a hand on his cousin's shoulder.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Carlos. Do not question the Crown'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Carlos. Do not question the Crown's justice."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I am not asking that Lucita be exo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not asking that Lucita be exonerated. Only that her life be spared."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What kind of monster do you think..."
entries.dialogueText: "What kind of monster do you think I am, General? I would never execute Duchess Azaro."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The punishment for those who betra..."
entries.dialogueText: "The punishment for those who betray the Crown is death. Are you implying the Duchess is above the law?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your love for your cousin moves me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your love for your cousin moves me. I will honor your request and spare her from execution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why stop there? Why shouldn't Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why stop there? Why shouldn't Rizia do away with the death penalty entirely?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos bowed."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos bowed.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""That is all I ask.""
entries.dialogueText: "That is all I ask."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right, Carlos. Death is too..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right, Carlos. Death is too good for Lucita. Your traitorous cousin should be tortured for the rest of her miserable life."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""No! That's not what I meant...""
entries.dialogueText: "No! That's not what I meant..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos bowed."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos bowed.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""That's most merciful of you, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's most merciful of you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""No... Only that if there is even a..."
entries.dialogueText: "No... Only that if there is even a slim possibility she is innocent, she should be given the benefit of the doubt."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Your Majesty, I still believe that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I still believe that the evildoers of Rizia should be punished to the full extent of the law. But my cousin is not among them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Everybody is somebody's cousin, ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everybody is somebody's cousin, aren't they? All criminals should similarly be given the benefit of the doubt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was speaking rhetorically. If I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was speaking rhetorically. If I spare Lucita, I'll get flooded with requests to spare everyone."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos and Taddeus both gave me loo..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos and Taddeus both gave me looks of offense.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was joking, Carlos. You know how..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was joking, Carlos. You know how much I love a good beheading."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Oh... Very funny.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh... Very funny."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Other countries have stopped using..."
entries.dialogueText: "Other countries have stopped using this barbaric form of punishment. Perhaps we really should consider it."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""That is a discussion for another t..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is a discussion for another time, I think."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I am speaking on behalf of House A..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am speaking on behalf of House Azaro. One of the oldest and most powerful noble families in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I am not asking for a removal of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not asking for a removal of the death penalty. I am asking for an exception, because this is an exceptional circumstance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lucita will live. And I will rethi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita will live. And I will rethink Rizia's policy of killing criminals."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. As long as I am King,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. As long as I am King, your cousin will not be executed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as the death penalty still..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as the death penalty still exists, every Rizian who has committed a serious enough felony will be subject to it. Without exception."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will consider your house's reque..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will consider your house's request. That is all I can promise."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I... thank you, Your Majesty. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "I... thank you, Your Majesty. You are most merciful."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Please consider our request. That..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please consider our request. That is all I ask."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Carlos. Your Majesty. Perhaps we s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Carlos. Your Majesty. Perhaps we should leave this be."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His face hardened into a scowl."
entries.dialogueText: His face hardened into a scowl.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Your Majesty. I truly beg you to r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. I truly beg you to reconsider."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I have certainly appreciated your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have certainly appreciated your commitment to strengthening the Rizian armed forces."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Rizia's armed forces are currently..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's armed forces are currently too weak to be put in such a position, but with more investment, it could work."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""If our troops achieve victory in P..."
entries.dialogueText: "If our troops achieve victory in Pales, the public will not only accept the change, but celebrate it."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""If we can overcome the current unr..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we can overcome the current unrest, I'm sure the public will accept the change."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""With my daughter in place as Queen..."
entries.dialogueText: "With my daughter in place as Queen Consort, I would ask that you appoint me to my old seat on the Royal Council to help plan the transition."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Realizing Ana Azaro's vision of a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Realizing Ana Azaro's vision of a monarcho-military alliance. We spoke of this while you were still convalescing, Father."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and Lucita looked at each other."
entries.dialogueText: He and Lucita looked at each other.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Done. There are no other suitable..."
entries.dialogueText: "Done. There are no other suitable candidates, anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you confident you have the hea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you confident you have the health and stamina to resume the position?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's it? This will be easier tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's it? This will be easier than I thought."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was hoping to reward Captain Gor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was hoping to reward Captain Gordion with the position. But I will consider you instead."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I do have one more request.""
entries.dialogueText: "I do have one more request."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As I served His Majesty Valero, so..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I served His Majesty Valero, so would I pledge to serve you."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""If this alliance is to work, the u..."
entries.dialogueText: "If this alliance is to work, the union of Azaro and Toras must last for generations to come."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""It is therefore my hope that if yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is therefore my hope that if your child is male, he will take his rightful place as successor to the throne of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry, Taddeus, but I cannot g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Taddeus, but I cannot guarantee that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course royal tradition will be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course royal tradition will be respected. If we have a boy, he will inherit the throne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My wife stepped backward, shaken."
entries.dialogueText: My wife stepped backward, shaken.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You can't?""
entries.dialogueText: "You can't?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our child will represent the union..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our child will represent the union of House Toras and House Azaro. A new way forward for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have no idea if Vina is even ali..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no idea if Vina is even alive or dead. As far as I'm concerned, Lucita's child is my only heir."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I made a promise to Vina long ago...."
entries.dialogueText: "I made a promise to Vina long ago. I can't break it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And after the way she humiliated y..."
entries.dialogueText: "And after the way she humiliated you, does she even deserve to be your heir?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We're doing our best to coordinate..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're doing our best to coordinate her rescue, but realistically, she might not make it back."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Thank you, Romus. That means so mu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Romus. That means so much."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me with pleading eyes..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me with pleading eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes... you're right. *If* we have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... you're right. *If* we have a son, he will take Vina's place as successor."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at Taddeus apologeticall..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at Taddeus apologetically.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We don't even know the sex of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't even know the sex of our child yet. I will make this decision when the time comes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She breathed a sigh of relief."
entries.dialogueText: She breathed a sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you truly love *me*, you'll und..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you truly love *me*, you'll understand why I have to put my daughter first."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""No, of course I'm not!""
entries.dialogueText: "No, of course I'm not!"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I know how much you love Vina. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know how much you love Vina. But if she loves you too, she'll understand."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are you saying? Are you *hopi..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you saying? Are you *hoping* my daughter never returns?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus sighed in frustration. Luci..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus sighed in frustration. Lucita looked at him apologetically.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina wants to be queen more than a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina wants to be queen more than anything. I can't take that away from her."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For political reasons, I must name..."
entries.dialogueText: "For political reasons, I must name my daughter as successor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A male heir ought not to be favore..."
entries.dialogueText: "A male heir ought not to be favored over his female older sibling. I intend to change that sexist policy."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But, Romus... what about us?""
entries.dialogueText: "But, Romus... what about us?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But, Romus... we don't even know w..."
entries.dialogueText: "But, Romus... we don't even know where Vina is."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My wife breathed a sigh of relief."
entries.dialogueText: My wife breathed a sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My wife stroked my arm."
entries.dialogueText: My wife stroked my arm.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Vina will come back, Romus. And wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina will come back, Romus. And when she does, she'll understand."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus sighed in frustration. Luci..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus sighed in frustration. Lucita looked at him apologetically.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your Majesty, if you cannot even c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, if you cannot even commit to follow royal tradition, than I don't see how we can work together."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""But of course, the Rizian military..."
entries.dialogueText: "But of course, the Rizian military is still at your disposal."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""So what's going to happen now?""
entries.dialogueText: "So what's going to happen now?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus smiled proudly."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus smiled proudly.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""History will remember this day.""
entries.dialogueText: "History will remember this day."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our next step should be to establi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our next step should be to establish a headquarters for the military in Porte Drazon. Ideally in or near Palas Rezna..."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""But we are getting ahead of oursel..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we are getting ahead of ourselves. For now, let's enjoy this evening."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I will submit my petition regardle..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will submit my petition regardless. I place my fate in your hands."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I was as saddened by my daughter's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was as saddened by my daughter's betrayal as you were. She certainly does not represent all of the Azaros."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus' expression turned mournful..."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus' expression turned mournful.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have members of House Azaro expres..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have members of House Azaro expressed any dissatisfaction about my reign?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus shook his head hurriedly."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus shook his head hurriedly.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""At some point during my recovery,..."
entries.dialogueText: "At some point during my recovery, I did hear talk amongst our house that you had intentions to reform the monarchy against the nobility's will."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""No. Well...""
entries.dialogueText: "No. Well..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Because if you *were* plotting aga..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because if you *were* plotting against me, I would find out. And I would crush your so-called noble house into a million bloody pieces."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do value honesty among my subjec..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do value honesty among my subjects. If I did find out that any member of House Azaro was planning to challenge the throne, the consequences would be *extremely* dire."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Please, Your Majesty. The Crown ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. The Crown has our fealty now and forever."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""It was a pleasure speaking with yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a pleasure speaking with you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He saluted once more as Carlos roll..."
entries.dialogueText: He saluted once more as Carlos rolled his wheelchair away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He saluted once more as Lucita roll..."
entries.dialogueText: He saluted once more as Lucita rolled his wheelchair away.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The Rizian royal family endowed wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizian royal family endowed with the strength of the military. A vision of what's to come, perhaps."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As I've mentioned before, the curr..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I've mentioned before, the current atmosphere mirrors that of 1926."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And the Royal Council, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "And the Royal Council, of course."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Father. He's made himself clear.""
entries.dialogueText: "Father. He's made himself clear."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""His Majesty's made himself clear,..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty's made himself clear, my cousin."
